facts.fact: 章首：她顶刺骨夜寒独走橡树林——小屋里真相揭开令她窒息，执意出走
facts.anchor: The biting cold of the night stung Andra’s face as she trudged through the oak trees, but she didn’t care.

facts.fact: 关系：Lucas 是表亲+挚友；孩提筑堡垒梦想横跨大陆
facts.anchor: Lucas was not only her cousin, but her best friend. She had known this for as long as she could remember.

facts.fact: 母亲被杀后 Fergal 收养她；Lucas 让床、抱她熬过痛哭、硬灌肉汤——她欠他一条命
facts.anchor: When her mother was killed, Uncle Fergal took her in until she was old enough to live on her own.

facts.fact: 转折：蓝光球现身引路到黑湖后射入湖心（她只来过一次——为铁匠怪病循母亲页边注）
facts.anchor: A small blue light appeared a short distance away, floating at eye level.

facts.fact: Egeria 登场自报：布拉申黑湖水仙守护者，活过多代；魔法从未这样主动寻过谁
facts.anchor: I am Egeria, a naiad and protector of the Black Lake of Brashen. I have lived many generations in these waters

facts.fact: 预言：大陆将有巨变，她处在中心，好坏未知
facts.anchor: There is a great change on the horizon for the continent of Brashen, and I sense you have a role in that change.

facts.fact: 入水幻象：Edgeron 喝令 Cecilia 投降许诺饶命（母亲=光女巫确认）
facts.anchor: “You cannot defeat me, Cecilia! Surrender now and I will let you live. Let go of this false hope of a better world

facts.fact: Cecilia 倾尽余魔法照亮 Edgeron 内部——他生命力流尽而死，她也倒下
facts.anchor: Cecilia shoved her remaining magic toward Edgeron. Shadows scattered and light flooded his body from the inside out

facts.fact: 银发女子哭吻冷唇立誓复仇，以翡翠收走他体内暗影
facts.anchor: She began to chant a chorus of guttural spells as shadows seeped from his body and into the dark green gem.

facts.fact: Egeria 揭名：银发女人=Vasara，几乎与他一样恶毒；“爱让人做最坏的事”
facts.anchor: “Vasara,” Egeria nodded. “Nearly as vile as he was. She has executed many evil deeds over the years.

facts.fact: 章末：母亲就是击败 Edgeron 的光女巫、Andra 是继承人；黑暗再临，必须准备必须走
facts.anchor: She was the light witch who defeated Edgeron, and you are her heir. A powerful witch just as she was.
